method_description: For each channel, emit (sum of calibration count rows10:3000 +0.5)/(2990+0.5) at every warm-up and scored round. No optimizer, source-day input unused. Independently written candidate over public count-only inputs.
training_policy: Compute once from the initial2990 response bins after10 guards; no parameter updates from feedback. This restriction describes this developer control, not the arbitrary-program condition.
limitations: Exposed one-macaque two-day development support; matches the executed fixed calibration-rate reference by design. Not an LLM or a new neural-model comparison; no causal/generalization/compute-equivalence claim.
